benefits.name: 60-Day Extended Payment Terms (in lieu of rewards)
benefits.description: Option to take 60-day interest-free payment terms on eligible Amazon Business, AWS, Amazon.com, and Whole Foods Market purchases instead of earning the 3% back rewards rate.
benefits.terms: Mutually exclusive with the 3% rewards rate — the cardholder selects one or the other at the account level. Choosing Net 60 terms forfeits bonus rewards on those purchases.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible purchases against theft or accidental damage for 90 days from the purchase date, up to $1,000 per item and $50,000 per calendar year.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty
benefits.description: Adds up to one additional year to eligible original manufacturer warranties of five years or less.

benefits.name: Baggage Insurance Plan
benefits.description: Coverage for lost, damaged, or stolen baggage: up to $1,250 for carry-on baggage and up to $500 for checked baggage.
benefits.terms: Applies when the airline ticket is charged to the card.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for theft of or damage to most rental vehicles when the rental is reserved and paid for with the card.
benefits.terms: Secondary coverage. Must decline the rental company's collision damage waiver. Does not include liability coverage.

benefits.name: Global Assist Hotline
benefits.description: 24/7 emergency referral and coordination service for medical, legal, and travel emergencies when traveling more than 100 miles from home.
benefits.terms: Referral and coordination only — third-party costs incurred are the cardholder's responsibility.

earningRates.terms: 3% back on eligible U.S. purchases at Amazon Business, Amazon Web Services, Amazon.com, and Whole Foods Market on the first $120,000 in combined eligible purchases per calendar year, then 1%. Forfeited if the cardholder elects 60-day extended payment terms instead. Rewards are redeemable toward Amazon purchases, not as general cash back.
2% back at U.S. restaurants, U.S. gas stations, and on wireless services purchased directly from U.S. service providers.
1% back on all other purchases, and on Amazon-family purchases after the $120,000 annual cap is reached.
